_about: ILLUSTRATIVE single-SKU scenario: an optical module stocked at a regional DC and replenished from an overseas factory either by ocean (LCL/FCL consolidation) or by air. Numbers are round, plausible-order-of-magnitude assumptions, not market data.

item._note: holding 25%/yr of value (capital + storage + obsolescence); backorder cost per unit per day; buyer owns goods in transit (e.g. bought FCA/FOB).

ocean._note: factory-to-DC incl. port dwell and clearance; per-order cost = booking, documents, drayage minimums

air._note: chargeable ~1.5 kg/unit x ~4.3 USD/kg incl. surcharges; per-order cost = airway bill, handling, clearance
